feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
entry.summary: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

entry.title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
entry.summary: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.

entry.title: Mike Johnson will step aside as top House Republican next Congress
entry.summary: After Tuesday's bruising defeat for Republicans, House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as minority leader come January.

entry.title: Back in the majority, Democrats have plans for a long list of Trump investigations
entry.summary: Democrats will have the ability to subpoena records and compel individuals to testify. The Epstein files, Elon Musk, the Iran war and Trump's business interests may all come under the microscope.

entry.title: Kansas just elected a Democrat. His message to Washington? Be decent
entry.summary: The Methodist pastor who flipped a Republican Senate seat says voters want more than political change. He tells NPR what he heard from Kansans about decency, faith and finding common ground.

entry.title: These 10 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
entry.summary: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.

entry.title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
entry.summary: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

entry.title: 'We have great leverage here': DNC chair Ken Martin on Democrats' midterms sweep
entry.summary: Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.

entry.title: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford beats Republican incumbent for governor
entry.summary: Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.

entry.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
entry.summary: El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.
